name: papertech-stage4-benchmark-v1
description: 论文 RAG 开发集；参考来源有限、非独立金标。两组共用题目和预算；不预设 Graph 胜出。

metadata.capture_scope: questions, paraphrased reference points and source IDs; no source text or vectors
metadata.prior_exposure: Stage3 previously used ToG/ToG-2 and HippoRAG examples; this is a development evaluation, not a held-out benchmark.

scoring.primary: macro SupportRecall@5: fraction of required evidence units with any known supporting chunk among top5 reranked candidates
secondary: MRR@40: reciprocal first rank containing any known supporting unit
scoring.denominator: 24 answerable questions; negatives separately; negatives with counterevidence excluded from recall aggregate
scoring.relevance: known source support pool, not exhaustive relevance judgments; absence from pool does not prove irrelevance
scoring.latency: retrieval compute measured around production methods, excludes audit stage uploads and shared cloud embedding batch; generation separately timed incl provider tracing
scoring.p95: numpy linear quantile over 24 single runs per arm, descriptive and unstable; not SLA or significance
scoring.answer_review: 10 frozen pairs; source-based delegated review of keypoints, citation support and gaps; no automated LLM judge; no acceptance threshold invented
scoring.interpretation: report paired gains, ties and regressions; no superiority or expansion decision from a single small development set
